name: budget_check
description: Reserve budget only immediately before the caller-made spend. Denials record attribution by default; no_record skips ingest. Use `solwyn budget check` followed by `solwyn budget confirm` only around a specific un-instrumented provider spend that you make yourself. Never wrap SDK-instrumented code with `budget check` or `budget confirm`; the Solwyn SDK already reserves and confirms that spend. Fail-open is explicit: when a check returns `allowed=true` and `reservation_id=null`, skip confirm. Do not create repeated unconfirmed checks. They temporarily hold budget and can cause self-denial.

name: budget_confirm
description: Settle only a non-null reservation after the caller-made spend. Records attribution with the same call_id by default; no_record skips ingest. Recording failure does not undo settlement. Use `solwyn budget check` followed by `solwyn budget confirm` only around a specific un-instrumented provider spend that you make yourself. Never wrap SDK-instrumented code with `budget check` or `budget confirm`; the Solwyn SDK already reserves and confirms that spend. Fail-open is explicit: when a check returns `allowed=true` and `reservation_id=null`, skip confirm. Do not create repeated unconfirmed checks. They temporarily hold budget and can cause self-denial.

name: budget_check_batch
description: Reserve budget immediately before multiple caller-made un-instrumented provider calls. Checks are JSON check bodies, fully validated before submission and chunked at 32; results preserve input order. Each allowed item holds its own reservation: confirm it after its call. Unknown models return per-item errors; 404/503 fail the request. Denials record one receipt unless no_record; stopped runs must not retry under a new run ID. Admission counts each item against checks_per_minute. Do not poll or replay to refresh reservations.
